serverpresence.notify.hidden: [Discord] Vanish detected: %s is hidden from your Discord presence.
serverpresence.notify.shown: [Discord] No longer vanished: %s is shown on Discord again.
serverpresence.discreet.on: [Discord] Discreet mode on: the server is no longer shown on Discord.
serverpresence.status.vanish.detected: Vanish: detected, server hidden on Discord.
serverpresence.status.vanish.delay: Vanish: checking after joining, server not shown yet.
serverpresence.settings.title: Discord Presence
serverpresence.settings.enabled.tooltip: Turns the Discord presence of the mod on or off.
serverpresence.settings.notify.tooltip: Chat message (only visible to you) when the server gets hidden or shown again because of the vanish.
serverpresence.settings.menus.tooltip: Show "In the menus" when you are not on a server.
serverpresence.settings.other.tooltip:
Servers missing from the list or disabled.
Generic: "Multiplayer", without name or IP.
Hidden: nothing on Discord.
serverpresence.settings.vanished.tooltip:
When you are vanished (or in discreet mode) on a server.
Generic: "Multiplayer", without name or IP.
Hidden: nothing on Discord.
serverpresence.settings.discreet.tooltip: Hides the current server until you disconnect, even without a detected vanish. Also with /presence discret or a key (Controls).
serverpresence.settings.head: Player head
serverpresence.settings.head.tooltip: Small image: the head of your skin, with your name.
serverpresence.settings.client_id.toolti: Application ID of a Discord application (discord.com/developers/applications). Any application works: "Playing …" shows the name of the server. Default: the PlatoMINE application.
serverpresence.settings.generic_name.too: Name shown in "Playing …" in menus, singleplayer and generic mode.
serverpresence.settings.menu_image.toolt: Image for menus, singleplayer and generic mode. Empty = 3D head of your skin. Otherwise: https link to an image, or name of an image (Art Asset) uploaded to the Discord application.
serverpresence.discord.no_client_id: Enter the ID of your Discord application above.
serverpresence.discord.not_found: Discord not found: is the desktop app running?
serverpresence.edit.title: Edit server
serverpresence.edit.enabled.tooltip: Disabled: this server is handled like an unlisted server.
serverpresence.edit.timer.tooltip: Show the time elapsed since joining.
serverpresence.edit.name: Name
serverpresence.edit.ip.tooltip: Address shown on Discord ({ip}). Also used to recognize the server and to find its logo.
serverpresence.edit.addresses.tooltip: Other addresses leading to this server, comma separated. *.domain.com = every subdomain. The port is ignored.
serverpresence.edit.activity_name.toolti: Name shown in "Playing …" on Discord. Variables: {server} {ip} {players} {player} {dimension} {version}
serverpresence.edit.image.tooltip:
Empty = logo of the server, fetched from its IP.
Otherwise: https link to an image, or name of an image uploaded to the Discord application.
serverpresence.edit.image_text.tooltip: Shown when hovering the logo. Variables: {server} {ip} {players} {player} {dimension} {version}
serverpresence.edit.button_label.tooltip: Clickable button below the presence (empty = no button). 32 characters max.
serverpresence.edit.button_url.tooltip: https link of the button (website, Discord of the server…).
serverpresence.edit.client_id.tooltip: Discord application for this server only (empty = general application). Rarely needed: the "Playing" name is set just above.
serverpresence.edit.vanish_detection.too: Hides the server on Discord while you are vanished on it.
serverpresence.edit.delay.tooltip: Seconds to wait after joining before showing the server, to detect a vanish that is already on.
serverpresence.edit.vanish_on.tooltip: Regular expression (case insensitive) searched in the server messages announcing the vanish. Player messages are ignored.
serverpresence.edit.vanish_off.tooltip: Regular expression of the messages announcing the end of the vanish (checked before "enabled").
serverpresence.edit.vanish_indicator.too: Regular expression of a text shown as long as you are vanished: scoreboard line, your name in the tab list, tab header/footer, boss bar or action bar.
serverpresence.edit.vanish_generic.toolt: Patterns for the usual vanish plugins (SuperVanish, PremiumVanish, EssentialsX, CMI…), in French and English.
serverpresence.edit.delete.title: Delete "%s"?
serverpresence.edit.delete.message: The server will be removed from the Discord presence list.
